name: Moedelo
description: Connect Moedelo (Моё Дело), the Russian online accounting service, to Claude or ChatGPT: counterparties and contracts, sales bills, acts, waybills, VAT invoices and UPDs, purchase documents, the bank and cash register, warehouses and goods, chart of accounts, employees and the tax calendar. Writes ship switched off.
instructions:
## Moedelo
This connector uses the **Moedelo REST API** (`https://restapi.moedelo.org`) of Моё Дело, the Russian online accounting service for small companies and sole traders: counterparties, contracts, sales bills, acts, waybills, VAT invoices and UPDs, purchase documents, the bank and cash register, warehouses and goods, the chart of accounts, employees and the tax calendar.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. Sign in to Moedelo, open **Настройки > Интеграция с партнерами**, turn the integration on and copy the API key it shows. If your account has no such option, request API access on moedelo.org (Моё Дело API page) or from apisupport@moedelo.org. The key looks like a GUID, `xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx`.
2. Paste it into `MOEDELO_API_KEY`. The connector sends it in the `md-api-key` header. The key opens the data of one company; for a second company, install the connector again with that company's key.

**How the data is organised**
- Counterparties (контрагенты) are both customers and suppliers. Their numeric `id` is the `kontragentId` filter of every document list.
- Sales documents: bills (счета), acts (акты), waybills (накладные, ТОРГ-12), VAT invoices (счета-фактуры, regular and advance) and UPDs. A bill's linked documents show the acts, waybills and payments that close it. Purchase documents mirror them for suppliers.
- Document lists filter by `number`, document date (`docAfterDate` / `docBeforeDate`, `YYYY-MM-DD`), change date (`afterDate` / `beforeDate`) and counterparty, and page with `pageNo` (from 1) and `pageSize`. Lists return `ResourceList` with the records, plus totals.
- Money: `moedelo_list_money_operations` is the register of all bank and cash operations for a period; read one in full with `moedelo_get_bank_operation` or `moedelo_get_cash_operation` by its `documentBaseId`.
- Amounts are in roubles; VAT types: -1 no VAT, 0, 10 or 20 percent.

**Writing**: creating and changing counterparties and creating sales bills are installed **switched off**. A bill only records what is owed: the connector never makes, registers or deletes payments. Turn a tool on only when the assistant should change Moedelo, and confirm each change with the user.

**Personal data**: employee lists and counterparties that are people (форма FL, IP) are personal data under 152-FZ. Share them only with people allowed to see them.

**Errors**: 401 or 403 means the key is wrong, revoked or belongs to another company; 404 on a detail tool means a wrong id; an empty `ResourceList` means nothing matched the filters.
prerequisites: A Moedelo (moedelo.org) account and the API key of your company, from Настройки > Интеграция с партнерами or from Moedelo support (apisupport@moedelo.org). One key covers one company.

MOEDELO_API_KEY.label: Moedelo API key
MOEDELO_API_KEY.help: Moedelo > Настройки > Интеграция с партнерами: turn it on and copy the key (or ask apisupport@moedelo.org). It is a GUID; one key opens one company.
MOEDELO_API_KEY.patternMessage: The key is a GUID: 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal characters, without quotes or spaces.

verifyHints.401: Moedelo refused the API key: it is wrong or was revoked. Copy the key again from Настройки > Интеграция с партнерами or ask apisupport@moedelo.org.
verifyHints.403: The key works but may not read this, or belongs to another company. Check that the key is the one of the company you want.

tools.name: moedelo_list_kontragents
tools.description: List counterparties (контрагенты: customers and suppliers) with id, INN, KPP, OGRN, name, type (buyer, supplier, both) and legal form. Search by INN or name.

isArchived.description: true for archived counterparties only, false for active only.

tools.name: moedelo_get_kontragent
tools.description: Read one counterparty in full: INN, KPP, OGRN, OKPO, names, legal and postal address, signer and legal form.

tools.name: moedelo_list_kontragent_bank_accounts
tools.description: List the bank accounts (расчётные счета) of a counterparty: bank, BIK, account and correspondent account.

tools.name: moedelo_list_kontragent_contacts
tools.description: List the contact persons of a counterparty with their position, phone and email.

tools.name: moedelo_list_contracts
tools.description: List contracts (договоры) with number, date, counterparty, subject and status. The contract id is the projectId of bills.

kontragentId.description: Only the contracts of this counterparty.

tools.name: moedelo_get_contract
tools.description: Read one contract (договор) in full: number, date, counterparty, subject, amounts and status.

tools.name: moedelo_list_bills
tools.description: List sales bills (счета на оплату) with number, date, counterparty, contract, sum, status (4 unpaid, 5 partly paid, 6 paid) and positions. Filters by number, document date, change date and counterparty; pages of pageSize.

number.description: Only documents whose number contains this text.

docAfterDate.description: Only documents dated on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

docBeforeDate.description: Only documents dated on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

afterDate.description: Only documents created or changed after this moment, ISO 8601 (for syncing changes).

beforeDate.description: Only documents created or changed before this moment, ISO 8601.

kontragentId.description: Only documents of this counterparty (numeric id from moedelo_list_kontragents).

projectId.description: Only bills under this contract (contract id).

tools.description: Read one sales bill (счёт) with its positions, VAT, payment status and contract.

tools.name: moedelo_list_bill_linked_documents

tools.name: moedelo_get_bank_operation
tools.description: Read one bank operation (Деньги / Банк) by its document id from moedelo_list_money_operations: type, counterparty, sum, purpose and linked documents.

tools.name: moedelo_get_cash_operation
tools.description: Read one cash desk operation (Деньги / Касса) by its document id from moedelo_list_money_operations.

tools.name: moedelo_list_settlement_accounts
tools.description: List the company's own bank accounts (расчётные счета): bank, BIK, account number and currency.

tools.description: List the company's cash desks (кассы) with their ids and names, for cash operations and balances.

tools.name: moedelo_get_cash_balance
tools.description: Get the balance of every cash desk of the company on a given date (остаток по кассам на дату).

tools.name: moedelo_list_warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses (склады) with their ids, names and type, for stock and purchase waybill filters.

includeCommissionAgentStocks.description: true to include warehouses held by commission agents.

tools.name: moedelo_list_goods
tools.description: List goods and materials (товары) with id, name, article, unit, prices and VAT.

name.description: Filter by product name (part of it).

afterDate.description: Only products created or changed after this moment, ISO 8601.

beforeDate.description: Only products created or changed before this moment, ISO 8601.

tools.name: moedelo_get_good
tools.description: Read one product (товар) in full: name, article, unit, sale and purchase price, VAT and group.

tools.name: moedelo_list_services
tools.description: List services (услуги) from the catalogue with name, unit, price and VAT. Search by name.

query.description: Text to search in service names; leave out for all.

count.description: How many services to return (Moedelo's default is 5).

tools.name: moedelo_list_chart_of_accounts
tools.description: List the chart of accounts (план счетов бухгалтерского учёта) with synthetic account codes and names.

tools.name: moedelo_get_document_postings
tools.description: Get the accounting postings (проводки) Moedelo generated for one document, by its base document id.

tools.name: moedelo_list_employees
tools.description: List employees (сотрудники) with name, position, department and hiring dates. Payroll data is personal: share it only with people allowed to see it.

tools.name: moedelo_list_tax_calendar
tools.description: List the events of the tax calendar (налоговый календарь): report and payment deadlines for the company.

tools.name: moedelo_create_kontragent
tools.description: Create a counterparty (контрагент) with its requisites. Installed switched off: confirm with the user first.

Name.description: Full name of the organisation, or the person's full name.

Type.description: Kontragent (buyer and supplier), Client, Partner or Other.

Form.description: Legal form: UL company, IP sole trader, FL person, NR non-resident.

InReason.description: Signer acts on the basis of (устав, доверенность).

tools.name: moedelo_update_kontragent
tools.description: Save changes to a counterparty. Moedelo replaces the record: send every field to keep, not only the changed ones. Installed switched off: confirm with the user first.

Name.description: Full name of the organisation, or the person's full name.

Type.description: Kontragent (buyer and supplier), Client, Partner or Other.

Form.description: Legal form: UL company, IP sole trader, FL person, NR non-resident.

InReason.description: Signer acts on the basis of (устав, доверенность).

tools.name: moedelo_create_bill
tools.description: Create a sales bill (счёт на оплату) for a counterparty. It records the bill only: no payment is made or registered. Installed switched off: confirm the counterparty, positions and VAT with the user first.

Number.description: Bill number; leave out to number it automatically.

ProjectId.description: Contract id, or -1 for the main contract.

SettlementAccountId.description: Own bank account id to show on the bill.

NdsPositionType.description: VAT: 1 none, 2 on top of prices, 3 included in prices.

AdditionalInfo.description: Additional information printed on the bill.

Items.description: Positions: [{"Type": 2, "Name": "Консультация", "Count": 1, "Unit": "усл.", "Price": 10000, "NdsType": 20}]. Type 1 goods (with StockProductId), 2 service. NdsType -1 no VAT, 0, 10 or 20 percent.
